dana: Hey team - onboarding a new client (acme-ai). Need quota increases across 2 Azure subscriptions for ND A100 v4 (8x) and NC T4 v3 (20x) in westeurope and uksouth. Created support cases:
- CASE 210012345001: ND A100 quotas (westeurope, sub-id: 5f3a1b2c-aaaa-4bbb-8ccc-123456abcdef)
- CASE 210012345002: NC T4 quotas (uksouth, sub-id: 6b4c2d3e-bbbb-4ccc-9ddd-abcdef123456)
Can someone ping Azure to expedite? We have a pilot starting next week. cc @liam @sre_eyal

opsbot: Automated: ticket 210012345001 assigned to Azure - response SLA 48h. Priority: Standard. (ref: auto-assign 2026-03-11T08:12:34Z)

liam: On it. I'll escalate via our partner rep. @cloud_support_rs can you take point and confirm we provided subscription IDs and VM SKUs? Also we need ENI/NIC limits raised — current NIC quota at 30 will be a blocker.

sre_eyal: FYI we'll also need vCPU soft limit increased in both subs. What's the expected burst timeline?

liam: Targeting Tue 03/10 for quota work. Partner rep said they can try to expedite to 24-36h if we include a short throughput forecast. I'll attach numbers.

maya: Sending workload numbers now:
```
peak_concurrent_instances: 12
avg_token_QPS: 1200
expected_2w_test_burst: 50_instances_for_2h_per_day
```

cloud_support_rs: Azure Support here. I've received the cases. CASE 210012345001 -> Escalated to engineering. ETA: 36h. CASE 210012345002 -> Pending subscription verification. Please DM tenant admin console role or provide SR# 987654 to link.

dana: Sent tenant admin invite (pending). Also added billing contact. Is there any chance to get temporary burst in another region (francecentral) while this is processed?

cloud_support_rs: We can provision temporary quota in francecentral if you accept higher spot pricing and a temporary allocation window. Reply with preferred region and duration and we'll add it to the cases.

liam: Let's request francecentral for 2 weeks, up to 20 ND A100 v4. Also increase NIC limit to 100 in both westeurope and uksouth. I'll update the cases with capacity numbers and tagging instructions.

cloud_support_rs: Noted. Updated CASE 210012345001: Added francecentral temporary allocation request (20x ND A100 v4 for 2 weeks). Updated CASE 210012345002: awaiting subscription link. Next update expected 2026-03-12 14:00 UTC. If you DM tenant admin role and SR# 987654 we can link and proceed faster.

opsbot: Reminder: please add cost center tag `cc:acme-ai` to subscription resources to avoid billing confusion.

sre_eyal: Quick ask: when quotas land we'll need a TF snippet to create scale sets. Example snippet to share with infra team:
```
resource "azurerm_linux_virtual_machine_scale_set" "llm_workers" {
  name = "acme-llm-ws"
  sku = "Standard_ND40rs_v4"
  capacity = 0 # start 0, scale via autoscaler
}
```

liam: Great. I'll keep thread updated and add TAM escalation if we don't see progress by tomorrow morning.

dana: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
